card.name: Partway through procedure and route phrases
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a clinical procedure or route phrase, just before the phrase's key noun, such as 'a' before bi-manual examination, 'vaginal' before ultrasonography, or 'peritone-al' before dialysis set.

modes.label: Before an exam or procedure noun
modes.description: A small word or adjective sits just ahead of the procedure it modifies.

modes.label: Inside route or drug words
modes.description: Partway through a route or drug word such as subcutaneous or levoleucovorin.

modes.label: Section heading word
modes.description: The word Patient in a numbered section heading about access to naloxone.
